_comment: Paste these tool definitions into Vera's ConvAI agent at elevenlabs.io/app/conversational-ai. Each tool maps to a POST endpoint on the Vouch backend. Replace {BASE_URL} with your tunnel URL during dev (ngrok / Cloudflare tunnel) or https://vouch.app in prod.

_dynamicVariables._comment: Configure these on the ConvAI agent (ElevenLabs UI > Dynamic Variables). The platform sets values per session before sending the first turn to Vera.

deal_id.description: Active deal UUID (empty for BUYER_ONBOARDING pre-creation).

counterparty_name.description: Other party's first name, if known.

amount_spoken.description: Pre-formatted amount string for natural speech (e.g. "four hundred pounds").

locale.description: BCP-47 language code. Default 'en'. Examples: pl (Polish), es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French). See VERA-SYSTEM-PROMPT.md § Multilingual.

tools.name: extract_terms
tools.description: Capture structured terms from the user's latest answer to one of the 5 onboarding questions. Call after EVERY user answer in BUYER_ONBOARDING. Merges into the deal's current term set.

user_input.description: The user's most recent spoken answer, verbatim.

tools.name: read_contract_back
tools.description: Recite the captured deal terms in the formal contract voice. Use after Q5 in BUYER_ONBOARDING and at the start of JOINT_SIGNOFF.

tools.name: read_buyer_terms
tools.description: Recite the buyer-committed terms to the seller. Use ONCE at the start of SELLER_ONBOARDING.

deal_id.description: Deal ID to recite buyer terms for.

tools.name: commit_buyer_side
tools.description: Commit the buyer's terms after they say 'I confirm'. Advances the deal to AWAITING_SELLER.

tools.name: commit_seller_side
tools.description: Commit the seller's agreement to the buyer's terms. Advances to AGREED, scheduling JOINT_SIGNOFF. Always pass seller_first_name = {{user_first_name}} so the deal record persists the seller's actual name.

seller_first_name.description: The seller's first name — pass {{user_first_name}} verbatim so the deal record gets persisted with their actual name (not the placeholder from buyer onboarding).

tools.name: extract_counter
tools.description: Capture seller's proposed changes to buyer's terms. Round-trips back to buyer for confirmation.

changes.description: Seller's spoken description of what to change.

tools.name: lock_escrow
tools.description: Lock the agreed amount in Stripe escrow. Call ONCE in JOINT_SIGNOFF after both parties say 'I agree'.

tools.name: release_escrow
tools.description: Release escrowed money to the seller. Call in VOICE_RECEIPT when buyer confirms delivery is acceptable.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Open a dispute on a deal. Freezes the money in escrow until resolved.

reason.description: User's stated reason for the dispute.

tools.name: replay_agreement
tools.description: Recite the original locked contract back to the disputing party in the formal contract voice.

tools.name: gather_dispute_evidence
tools.description: Capture the disputing party's evidence summary and prompt for media upload.

user_summary.description: What the user said is different from the agreement.

tools.name: flag_for_review
tools.description: Pause the deal and route to human review. Use for amounts outside the usual range, ambiguous declines, or repeated tool failures.

tools.name: refund_deal
tools.description: Refund the deal back to the buyer. Use when a dispute resolves in the buyer's favour. Reverses both the original capture and the platform fee, clawing funds back from the seller's Connect balance. Only legal once the deal is IN_ESCROW or RELEASED.

reason.description: Stripe refund reason — one of 'duplicate', 'fraudulent', or 'requested_by_customer'. Defaults to 'requested_by_customer'.
